round1_status.evidence: Dialog still has a hint and a visible label, no app tile, unlike the generic ConnectionDialog (round-1 text). Help link now added, so the gap is smaller; severity lowered.
Dialog now shows the link 'Where to find your key' under the field (target is '#', not observable).
No Devin tile is drawn in v3; still unobservable.
Caption under the dialog frame: 'Connect closes the dialog and opens /app/devin.' This is a caption, not a drawn frame, so the landing is planned behaviour.
Not connected frame now sits inside the shell with sidebar, one line 'Connect Devin to see its sessions here.' and one primary button.
Disabled-Connect (empty field) and error states of the dialog are not drawn; only the prefilled state. The after-connect result is now covered by the caption.
Not connected frame shows the Devin sidebar link without a dot.
Loading skeleton, empty, load error and stale frames are drawn.
ACUs and PRs open tiles and the ACUs column are gone; only Needs you and Working tiles remain.
Titles wrap (no ellipsis) and the question wraps to two lines at 1440 and at every width tested. Residual clamp logged as F-STORY-004-06.
Geometry audit at 1440, 1100, 900, 390: overflowSpills is empty; PR cells no longer spill.
'First visit, panel closed' frame exists; the Ask button is the only entry. The closed-to-open transition is not drawn (F-STORY-012-08).
Needs you tile has an amber border and amber value, and the Needs you group is first. Squint test: tile and dot now read as the lead signal.
Count is still stated by tile, dot (no number), two badges, and the agent reply in the open-panel frame. The header count and the ACUs repeat are gone, so severity lowered.
Measured at 1440 light: warning badge text 3.48:1, success badge text 4.17:1 (12px). Unchanged tokens. Destructive 4.62:1 passes.
Sidebar dot is a span with aria-label '2 need you' and role=null.
Empty frame draws no tiles; 'Needs you 0' with other sessions present (dot gone, tile not emphasised) is not drawn.
Each needs-you row has a visible 'Answer in Devin' link with an external-link icon; keyboard focus ring is visible.
No refresh control or cue is drawn; the header shows 'Updated 4m ago' only on the stale frame. The refetch rule is planned behaviour and cannot be observed in the static mockup.
Wait time is still only the Updated column.
Ask is hidden whenever the panel is open: 1440 open frame, and after clicking Ask at 1100, 900, 390.
User bubbles are still purple (bot colour). Not re-checked against the real bubble story this round.
Tool rows now read 'Session search' and 'Session get messages x2' (noun first, like 'Mail search'); the invented verbs are gone. Not compared with humanizeToolName output.
At the 384px panel, 'Open in Devin' stays on one line in both bullets (no orphan word).
Panel collapse icon measured 28x28.
No suggestion chip; the first-open intro state is not drawn.
Agent reply still shows only the ideal case; wording when question text cannot be read is not drawn.
Toast title 'Devin has a question', body '<session title>: <question>', caption says click opens the session in Devin. Remaining duplication is logged under F-STORY-008-02.
Body when the question is unavailable is not drawn.
Dot clearing rule is not observable and still undecided in the catalog.
Width switcher: 1100 keeps sidebar and shows overlay panel (dock 384, absolute); 900 and 390 swap the sidebar for a top bar; no frame overflow (pg scrollWidth equals clientWidth).
At 390 the table becomes a list with the badge at top right, 'Answer in Devin' inside the row, and a Pull request/Source/Updated block.
Open overlay covers Pull request, Source, Updated at 1100 and 900 (dock left edge 716 of 1100, 516 of 900). Same pattern as the real app; status and title stay visible. Severity lowered.
Real viewport 390: dialog stays 440px, document scrollWidth 456 (66px overflow), Connect button clipped. Mockup artifact.
Decision: mobile gets push only, no native screen. Residual question (push tap target) moved to catalog GAP-48.

new_findings.description: Connect dialog does not say the connection is shared with the whole space or that every member will see all org sessions; hint still says 'org-scoped' (jargon).
new_findings.expected: One connection per space is now the rule, so the person connecting should know who it exposes.
new_findings.actual: Dialog: 'An org-scoped Devin service-user key (starts with cog_).' only.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Replace 'org-scoped' with a plain phrase and add one short clause only if needed.

new_findings.description: Ask button is drawn on Not connected, Loading, Empty and Load error frames; before connecting there is no Devin agent, and what Ask does is not drawn.
new_findings.expected: Controls that cannot work are hidden until they can.

new_findings.description: Not connected frame does not cover a member who is not allowed to connect or replace the shared connection; no 'ask whoever connected it' state is drawn.
new_findings.expected: State for members who cannot connect.
new_findings.actual: Same Connect Devin button for everyone.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Decide who may connect, then draw one variant.

new_findings.description: Key-rejected frame keeps the tile (2), the Needs input badges, 'Answer in Devin' links and the sidebar dot looking live. The notice says only 'Devin rejected the key.'; nothing says alerts have stopped, and a member who did not connect gets a Reconnect button with no word on who can use it.
new_findings.expected: Stale rows are marked as stale and the user learns that needs-you alerts are off.
new_findings.actual: Notice plus full live-looking page; 'Updated 4m ago' in the header is the only stale cue.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Dim the tile and dot while stale, or add three words to the notice.

new_findings.description: At the open-panel width (page column 740px) the second needs-you question clamps at two lines with an ellipsis ('...the older one...'). Full text only in Devin.
new_findings.expected: Ellipsis with the full value reachable.
new_findings.actual: Clamped; the 'Answer in Devin' link is the way to read more.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Accept (GAP-45 chose the clamp) or add a title attribute.

new_findings.description: 'Answer in Devin' link measures 102x18px; both small. Under the 24px minimum target of WCAG 2.2.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Add vertical padding to the link.

new_findings.description: Each needs-you row has two links (title and 'Answer in Devin') that presumably open the same Devin session, so two tab stops per row; row hover highlights the whole row with a pointer cursor but a click on the row outside the links does nothing.
new_findings.expected: One route per task and hover that matches what is clickable.
new_findings.actual: Both links have href '#'; tab order: title, Answer, title, Answer.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Make the whole row the link or drop the row hover; keep one tab stop.

new_findings.description: Toast frame is drawn on the Devin page itself (needs-you rows visible behind it), although the catalog proposes suppressing it on /app/devin; the toast also covers the right part of the Working rows.
new_findings.expected: Toast not shown on the page that already shows the fact.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Confirm suppression rule; redraw frame on another page (for example Inbox).

new_findings.description: Under 1024px the sidebar dot is hidden with the sidebar and the top bar has no indicator; the top bar names the page 'Devin agent' while the page title is 'Devin'.
new_findings.expected: Needs-you signal reachable at every width; one name per screen.
new_findings.actual: Top bar: menu icon and 'Devin agent'; no dot.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Dot on the menu button; top bar shows the page name.

new_findings.description: Three labels for one state: group and tile 'Needs you', row badge 'Needs input', toast 'Devin has a question'.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Pick 'Needs you' for tile, group and badge; keep the toast wording.
